can: Consigo comparar meios de transporte e rotas, e pedir direções e informações de transporte.

lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Transporte (fare, platform, delay, traffic jam, commute), phrasal verbs (get on / off, get in / out of, pick up, drop off).

items: **get on / get off:** ônibus, trem, avião, bicicleta.
**get in / get out of:** carro, táxi.
**pick up / drop off:** buscar / deixar alguém.
"I go to work by foot." O certo é **on foot** (ou: I walk to work).
"I lost the bus." O certo é **I missed the bus.**
"There were many transits." O certo é **There was a lot of traffic.** (traffic não tem plural)

exercises.prompt: I ___ the bus, so I was late for work.
He lives far away and ___ (commute) two hours every day.
You get ___ the bus, but you get ___ a taxi.
I go to work by foot.
acc: I go to work on foot

exercises.prompt: There were many transits on the highway.
acc: There was a lot of traffic on the highway

chat.scenario: Você conta a um colega como é seu trajeto e como foi uma viagem difícil.
chat.role: Colega que pergunta sobre o trajeto e os problemas.
chat.goal: 6 palavras da aula e 1 phrasal verb.

lessons.title: Comparativos e superlativos
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Comparativos e superlativos (faster than, the most expensive, as...as, much / a bit + comparativo).

head: Tipo de adjetivo
Comparativo
Superlativo
rows: good, better / bad, worse / far, further
the best / the worst / the furthest

aula.text: **as...as:** *The bus is as fast as the train.* Negativa: *The bus isn't as fast as the train.*
**Intensidade:** *much / a lot / a bit + comparativo*: *The train is much cheaper.*

items: "more cheap", "more fast" e "more better" não existem. O certo é **cheaper**, **faster**, **better**.
"bigger that" está errado. O certo é **bigger than**.
"the most good" está errado. O certo é **the best**.

exercises.prompt: The train is ___ (fast) than the bus.
Which is ___ (expensive) way to travel: plane, train or bus?
This road is ___ (bad) than the other one.
Walking is more cheap that taking a taxi.
acc: Walking is cheaper than taking a taxi

exercises.prompt: He is the most good driver I know.
acc: He is the best driver I know
he's the best driver I know
he is the best driver I know

exercises.prompt: A motorbike isn't ___ safe ___ a car.

chat.role: Agente de viagens que apresenta as opções.

lessons.title: Inglês prático, direções e informações
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Pedir direções e informações de transporte.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Excuse me, how do I get to...? / Could you tell me the way to...? / Is it far from here?
Go straight ahead. / Turn left (right) at the traffic light. / Take the second street on the left.
It's next to... / opposite... / behind... / on the corner.
It's about five minutes on foot.
Which platform does the train to... leave from? / How much is a single ticket? / What time is the next bus to...?

aula.text: **Erro comum:** "How can I go to the station?" O certo é **How can I get to the station?**

exercises.prompt: The bank is ___ the supermarket. (em frente)
How can I go to the station?
acc: How can I get to the station?

exercises.prompt: Pergunte o horário do próximo trem para Campinas.
exercises.ref: What time is the next train to Campinas?
